ambiguities.text: The specification does not define error response format for invalid GraphQL queries or schema violations.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard GraphQL error response format with 'errors' array is used. This should be verified against implementations.

ambiguities.text: The handling of 'null' returns for transactionAt(index) and ommerAt(index) when index exceeds bounds is mentioned but not specified for error vs null response.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume null is returned as a valid GraphQL response value rather than an error. Implementations may vary.

ambiguities.text: Rate limiting, authentication, and access control mechanisms are not specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume these are implementation-specific and outside the scope of this EIP. Operators must implement their own protections.

implicit_assumptions.description: The GraphQL endpoint assumes network-level access control is handled externally (firewall, reverse proxy, etc.).
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Unauthenticated access to sensitive blockchain data; potential DoS via expensive queries.

implicit_assumptions.description: Client implementations correctly validate and sanitize input before sending to the API.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Injection attacks or malformed queries could exploit parser vulnerabilities.

implicit_assumptions.description: The separation of signing functionality to external daemons assumes secure communication between components.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If external signing daemon is compromised, transactions could be forged or intercepted.
